card.name: The word until after wait
card.fires_on: The word "until" directly after a form of "wait" (wait, waits, waited, waiting), often in "do not wait until" or "wait until" phrases.

modes.label: Wait until in dosing instructions
modes.description: "Until" after "do not wait" in missed-dose instructions that refer to the next planned dose.
modes.example: Administer PERJETA 420 mg intravenously as soon as possible. Do not wait<< until>> the next planned dose.

modes.label: Wait until in general advice or narrative
modes.description: "Until" after a form of wait in general web text, describing delaying an action or event.
modes.example: You don't have to wait<< until>> night to see planets and stars.
